messages:
alex.k: Heads up — targeting golden-image v3.2.0 for tonight's engine roll. This includes a kernel ABI bump and q8 quant artifacts (tag: q8-v2). Need decision on pinning EU vs US and a rollback checklist.
maria_p: +1. Do we have a green staging run? any flaky smoke in eu-west last night?
deploybot: preflight report: staging smoke ✅ except eu-west-1: 1 instance showed kv-cache growth after 30m (heap +15%). logs uploaded: https://internal.ci/runs/94231
jin: timeline? when is the change window? ops prefers after 23:00 UTC.
sam: if eu-west is flaky i'd prefer pin there and only roll us-east/us-west for the first batch. we can push a hotpatch if necessary.
leo: agree. Also we need to add explicit fallback to matmul-v1 kernels if q8-v2 path errors out — that was missing in previous roll.
irene: rollback criteria proposal: revert if 95th pct latency increases >15% for >10m OR error rate spike >0.5% absolute for >5m. Also auto-unpin after 6h unless manually extended.
alex.k: sounds good. Let's split rollout: batch A = us-east/us-west, batch B = eu regions (pinned). If batch A passes 45m smoke we open batch B.
maria_p: who will own release notes? need bullets: kernel ABI bump, q8-v2 quant, fallback behavior, pinned regions, RC/commit hashes, CI run link.
alex.k: i'll draft notes. payload ids: golden-image:v3.2.0 (sha: b7e9c4), kernel: 2.14.1-abi2, quant:q8-v2 (artifact 2026-03-20T18Z).
ops-bot: oncall: @jin is primary, @sam is backup for this window. Maintenance window start: 2026-03-20T23:00Z. ETA 2h.
deploybot: deploy plan created: plan-id 98423 - canary slice=2%, ramp steps: 2->10->50->100 over 30m. sticky-pin support enabled for eu regions.
jin: checklists: 1) verify staging smoke logs 2) confirm fallback kernels present on all hosts (`/opt/runtime/kernels/*`) 3) warm KV cache config 4) alerting dashboards set (95th lat, err rate, kv mem).
sam: quick smoke commands: ``curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV' https://staging.api.redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq .choices[0].text`` run from staging jumpbox.
leo: run that in parallel in each region, watch eviction/gc logs: `journalctl -u runtime -f | grep -i kvcache`
irene: I'll own rollback if we hit thresholds. If rollback happens, we pin to golden-image:v3.1.9 and open a postmortem.
maria_p: also add one-line note for support: "If customers report hallucinations or token regressions, route to model-qa@redwood".
alex.k: decision summary: rollout tonight at 23:00Z. Batch A (US) = proceed. Batch B (EU) = pinned until explicit thumbs-up. Rollback thresholds agreed (irene owns). Release notes draft by me in #release-notes in 15m.
deploybot: reminder: plan 98423 scheduled at 2026-03-20T23:05Z unless cancelled.
sam: I'll standby for post-deploy smoke and can flip the eu pin once we're green. :thumbsup:
jin: I'll enable extra logging for first 60m of batch A and add a temporary alert with 3-min eval lookback.
alex.k: thanks all — updating docs and release notes now. If anything changes ping me directly. :rocket:
